details.title: Pilot Services Agreement

governing_law_source.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India. ... The seat and venue of arbitration shall be Mumbai and the language shall be English. Subject to the above, the courts at Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

details.parties_quote: BlueOrchid Hotels Pvt Ltd, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, having its registered office at 11th Floor, Orchid Towers, Senapati Bapat Marg, Lower Parel, Mumbai 400013, Maharashtra, India (hereinafter "BlueOrchid" or the "Client", which expression shall include its successors and permitted assigns); AND AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, bearing CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456 and GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3, having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India (hereinafter "AtliQ" or the "Service Provider", which expression shall include its successors and permitted assigns).

payment_source.quote: AtliQ shall raise an invoice on completion of each Milestone. BlueOrchid shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of receipt.

details.services_summary: Deliver a guest review analytics solution including automated ingestion, multilingual sentiment analysis, Power BI dashboards, and weekly summaries.

liability_cap.basis: total fees paid or payable under this Agreement
liability_cap.quote: Except for breach of confidentiality, fraud or wilful misconduct, each Party's total aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid or payable under this Agreement.

delay_penalty.quote: If AtliQ fails to complete a Milestone by its scheduled date for reasons solely attributable to AtliQ, BlueOrchid shall be entitled to liquidated damages of 0.5% of the relevant Milestone Fee for each complete week of delay, subject to a maximum of 5% of that Milestone Fee.

findings.title: Al Noor Hospitality Group: Data analytics, AI or revenue-management services
findings.why: The deal involves guest analytics for a hospitality business in UAE and Oman, which directly conflicts with the non-compete scope covering hospitality businesses in those regions.
findings.comparison: Do not take analytics, AI or revenue-management work for hotel groups in the GCC until about September 2029 without Al Noor's written consent.
findings.quote: the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.
findings.exception: Clause 12.4 lets Al Noor waive it per engagement by written consent. Waiver letter of 10 Feb 2026 allows only the Seaside Hotels (Muscat) demand-forecasting SOW; not follow-on SOWs, other hotels or Affiliates.

findings.title: Cross-border data processing
findings.why: Processing data across UAE and Oman may trigger complex local data residency and privacy compliance requirements not addressed in the contract.
findings.comparison: AtliQ typically operates under Indian law; international data transfers require specific legal safeguards.
findings.quote: 10 | BlueOrchid Dubai Business Bay | Dubai | United Arab Emirates | 11 | Orchid Residences Dubai Marina | Dubai | United Arab Emirates | 12 | BlueOrchid Muscat Qurum | Muscat | Oman

findings.title: Expired restriction: Orbit Travels (Developing, licensing or providing travel-booking software)
findings.why: Travel-booking software for an online travel agency in India.
findings.comparison: Expired. Shown for confidence: AtliQ could not build travel-booking software for Indian online travel agencies until 30 June 2025.
findings.quote: it shall not develop, license or provide travel-booking software to any online travel agency operating in India.
findings.exception: Clause 6.2: hotels, airlines and other businesses that are not online travel agencies are not restricted. Scanned copy with OCR errors; read with care.

findings.title: Data processing outside India
findings.why: AtliQ must ensure compliance with international data laws if processing data for properties outside India, increasing operational risk.
findings.comparison: Standard for global projects, but requires careful monitoring of local compliance requirements.
findings.quote: including the laws applicable to Properties located outside India.
